0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_1
0.description: No new letters for you today, kupo!

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_001
1.description: Well, if it isn't our favorite delivery <hex:020946E948FF0548797572FF07456C657A656EFF094C616C6166656C6CFF084D69716F277465FF09526F65676164796EFF064175205261FF0948726F7468676172FF06566965726103>! No new letters for you today, kupo!

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_100_001
2.description: There's a smile made of <hex:020963E948FF0973756E7368696E65FF0A737461726C69676874FF0A707570707920666174FF0F6D696C6B20616E6420686F6E6579FF0D69726F6E20616E6420696365FF0F6669726520616E6420626C6F6F64FF06737465656CFF0A6D6F6F6E6265616D7303>! I can deny you nothing─except new letters. There are none, kupo.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_101_001
3.description: While I'd love nothing more than to deliver a letter to my proud protégé, I fear there is nothing for you today, kupo.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_001
4.description: Why, hello! <hex:022903EB0203>, was it? I'm afraid I don't have any letters for you today. If I <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103>, of course, I'd deliver them to you with speed and gusto!

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_3
10.description: Your mailbox is filling up fast! You should do something about it quick, or I won't be able to fit in any more letters, kupo!

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_003
11.description: Your mailbox is filling up fast! You should do something about it quick, or I won't be able to fit in any more letters! I would have expected our favorite assistant to be more organized, kupo!

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_100_003
12.description: Your mailbox is filling up fast! I won't be able to fit in any more letters unless you do something, kupo! And then where will you be?

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_101_003
13.description: A consummate carrier like yourself letting <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> mailbox go unattended? This simply won't do, kupo! Do some cleaning, and with haste, lest there be no room for new deliveries!

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_003
14.description: Your mailbox is filling up fast! You should do something about it quick, or I won't be able to fit in any more letters!

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_004
16.description: Your mailbox is a complete and utter mess! There wasn't any room left, so I had to send back <hex:02087CE4E80202FF0961206C6574746572FF6C020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303206C65747465727303>, kupo! Perhaps you've been spending too much time delivering others' letters and not enough attending to your own?

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_100_004
17.description: Your mailbox is a complete and utter mess! There wasn't any room left, so I had to send back <hex:02087CE4E80202FF0961206C6574746572FF6C020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303206C65747465727303>, kupo! The phrontists say that a letter carrier with an unkempt mailbox is like a barber with an unbled cousin...

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_101_004
18.description: Your mailbox is a complete and utter mess! There wasn't any room left, so I had to send back <hex:02087CE4E80202FF0961206C6574746572FF6C020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303206C65747465727303>, kupo! To see my prized pupil be so careless─why, it brings a tear to my eye...

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_004
19.description: Your mailbox is filling up fast! You should do something about it quick, or I won't be able to fit in any more letters, kupo!

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_10
20.description: Greetings, tall one! I'm a delivery moogle, kupo!

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_11
21.description: Oh, I know what you're thinking. “Moogles are supposed to hide in trees and avoid contact with outsiders! Whyever would they agree to carry about letters?”

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_12
22.description: "Why" indeed! If I had <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> way, I'd be curled up under the canopy of a nice oak dreaming about some beautiful mooglette with a rainbow-colored pom-pom, kupo!

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_13
23.description: But <hex:021A020203>no<hex:021A020103>, the moon had to go and drop from the sky, causing all of that terrible commotion! Aetherytes were shattered and linkpearls rendered useless. For moons, the poor, wingless people of Eorzea had no way of communicating with each other...beyond screaming at the top of their lungs, which no one really approved of, kupo.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_14
24.description: That is, until the little horned ones asked us to assist them by delivering messages. At first we were wary of showing ourselves, worried that one of you might catch and skin us, like you do every other forest furry. But once we saw how much we were appreciated, we knew we'd found our new calling!

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_15
25.description: And I personally promise to <hex:021A020203>try<hex:021A020103> and not read any along the way, kupo!

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_010
26.description: Greetings and salutations! Wondering why I'm wearing this funny hat and toting around this oversized bag, kupo? Well, it just so happens that I had a dream the other night. A dream of moogles like me who spent their days delivering letters to travelers like you.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_011
27.description: I thought, I could do that─so here I am! Should Feo Ul happen to receive any missives or epistles for you from beyond, I'll ensure that they safely find their way into your hands, kupo.

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_000_020
28.description: Your speedy and accurate deliveries have earned you carrier level <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303>, kupo! And yet, a delivery moogle's work is never done. Should you see the deputy postmoogle outside Limsa Lominsa's Bulwark Hall, that's your sign that we have another job for you!

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_020
29.description: Your unflagging dedication to letter delivery has earned you carrier level <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303>, kupo! I'm not certain what that means, I'm afraid, but Feo Ul insisted that I pass on the word. They also mentioned that if you're looking for more work, you should speak to the moogle who looks like me, but lives by the sea beyond.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_100_020
30.description: Your postal prowess has earned you carrier level <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303>, kupo! A letter carrier's heart is a restless one, always thinking of the next job. If the deputy postmoogle has another letter for you, he'll be outside Limsa Lominsa's Bulwark Hall. Run to him, kupo. Run, don't walk!

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_101_020
31.description: I must convey my congratulations again! Where once stood a rank amateur, now stands a veritable maestro of mail carrying, kupo. The countless postmoogles you have inspired are carrying your torch well. We may call upon you again, but until that day─stay safe in your adventures!

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_021
32.description: Feo Ul was saying that the delivery moogles from “beyond”─wherever that is, kupo─have high hopes for you! I wonder if they have high hopes for me, too?

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMOGLETTER_00002_LETTERMOOGLE_102_030
33.description: Every day, I train and toil that I might one day be as peerlessly proficient at my profession as the postmoogle I met in my dreams, kupo!
